title: Cute book-aesthetic 1-year anniversary single-page site for VEERA

requirements.summary: Build a single-page anniversary landing experience with an English hero message that prominently includes “VEERA” and celebrates the 1-year milestone.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing view contains the name “VEERA” prominently.
Landing view clearly states it is a 1-year anniversary/1st year celebration message in English.
All user-facing text is in English.

file_operations.description: Create the single-page App shell that renders the book experience and includes an above-the-fold hero message prominently featuring “VEERA” and an explicit 1-year anniversary celebration line in English. Wire in the main Book component and ensure no additional routes/pages are introduced.
Ensure the document title and metadata align with the 1-year anniversary theme for VEERA (English-only user-facing text).

requirements.summary: Implement a book-inspired UI with a distinct cover and at least three inner pages with clear navigation and book-like transitions on mobile and desktop.
acceptanceCriteria: UI includes a distinct cover-like first view and at least 3 inner pages (e.g., Message, Memories, Closing).
User can navigate between pages with clear controls (Next/Previous and/or page dots).
Page transitions feel book-like (e.g., page flip/slide) and are responsive on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Create the core Book container that manages current page state (cover + 3+ inner pages), renders page indicators, and provides Next/Previous controls. Use the shadcn-ui Button component for navigation controls (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing). Add responsive book-like transitions (page flip/slide feel) using Tailwind utility classes and minimal custom CSS classes.

Create the cover view with a cover-like layout (title, subtitle, decorative illustration) and an obvious control to open/continue into the book. Ensure the cover text includes VEERA and the 1-year celebration messaging in English.
Create an inner page for a heartfelt anniversary message (English-only), laid out like a storybook page (paper panel, headings, small doodle accents).

Create an inner page for a short 'memories' section (English-only) with a cozy, scrapbook-like layout (cards/panels). Use shadcn-ui Card (or equivalent shadcn-ui surface component) if available (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
Create a closing inner page (English-only) with a warm sign-off, optional 'back to cover' action, and a final decorative motif.
Wire the new Book component into the App so the entire experience remains a single page and is directly reachable at the app root.

requirements.summary: Apply a consistent, accessible cute/cozy storybook theme (warm tones, storybook typography, consistent components) avoiding blue/purple as primary colors.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme uses warm/cozy tones (e.g., cream, tan, soft browns) with consistent typography resembling a storybook/handwritten feel.
All pages share consistent component styling (buttons, headings, cards/panels).
Design is accessible: text contrast is readable and layout works on small screens.

file_operations.description: Create global styling for the book/paper aesthetic: warm background, readable foreground, consistent spacing defaults, and typography stacks that feel storybook-like (without relying on external integrations). Define CSS variables that map to Tailwind/shadcn tokens (background/foreground/primary/etc.) using warm cream/tan/brown hues and ensure accessible contrast.

Extend Tailwind theme to support the cozy book palette and reusable styling primitives (e.g., additional warm color tokens, shadows for paper depth, animation utilities for page transitions) while keeping blue/purple out of primary styling.

Apply consistent component styling (buttons, page panels, headings) across cover and inner pages using Tailwind utilities and existing shadcn-ui components where appropriate (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing). Ensure responsive layout and readable text contrast on small screens.

requirements.summary: Add and wire static decorative visuals (cover illustration, paper texture background, doodle icons) from generated assets into the UI without backend image serving.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images are stored under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly by the frontend (no backend image serving).
At least one decorative image appears on the cover and at least one subtle texture/background element appears on inner pages.
Images are optimized for web display and do not break layout on mobile.

file_operations.description: Add the generated cover illustration asset at this exact path so it can be referenced directly by the frontend (no backend involvement).
Add the generated seamless paper texture asset at this exact path for use as subtle backgrounds on inner pages.
Add the generated doodles set sprite/atlas asset at this exact path for small decorative accents throughout the UI.
Reference frontend/public/assets/generated/anniversary-cover.dim_1600x900.png as a decorative visual on the cover. Ensure responsive sizing so it never overflows or breaks layout on mobile.

Use frontend/public/assets/generated/paper-texture.dim_2048x2048.png as a subtle background/texture element on the page surface. Add small doodle accents by referencing frontend/public/assets/generated/doodles-set.dim_1024x1024.png in a lightweight, non-intrusive way.

Add at least one decorative doodle accent using frontend/public/assets/generated/doodles-set.dim_1024x1024.png and ensure images remain optimized in layout (no large unbounded rendering) for mobile and desktop.
